<thought>The high‑resolution m/z 134.10955 peak corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of 133.102 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₀H₁₃ (exact mass 133.1017 Da). This fits the observed isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1 intensity, consistent with ~10 carbons). Hence the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
